description: 200 Bitcoin mainnet winning nonces imported from the HYBA mining workbench bundle for PYTHIA structure-only learning.
height_sampling: 20 groups of 10 descending contiguous heights, groups separated by 90 heights
verification_detail: The bundled fresh-analysis artifact reports 200/200 rows locally PoW-verified by rebuilding each 80-byte header, matching the reported block id, and checking double-SHA256 against compact bits. The bundled CSV itself contains only height and nonce, so the import additionally records independent public-chain spot checks rather than misrepresenting a second full 200-row re-verification.
synthetic_policy: Synthetic/random data may be used only as an explicitly labelled null/control set and is never inserted into PYTHIA's real structural training split.
training_semantics: unlabelled structure only; no success/failure classification label is manufactured

resonance_semantics.existing_structure_threshold_phi_inverse: separate runtime lane-selection threshold; not changed by this import

claim_boundary: Training may influence learned representation and search ordering only. SHA256d plus target comparison remains the sole proof/acceptance authority.
